title: Baltimore Comedy.org
text:
What This Is
Baltimore has an enormous amount of comedic talent and, historically, a scattered way of advertising it — a flyer taped to a pole, a group chat, a hard-to-find Instagram Story. Baltimore Comedy.org exists to fix that: one place where local comedians can be found, booked, and followed, and where audiences can find out where the shows are.


🎤 Find Shows
Open mics, showcases, and one-off specials around the city, listed with dates.


🎭 Find Comedians
A growing roster of Baltimore-area comics, with bios and links to their socials.


📋 Get Listed
Running a show or want your profile added? Submit it through the form and it’ll go up once it’s reviewed.



Add Your Show or Profile →
